note: TRANSCRIBED FROM APPENDIX A AND FROM NOWHERE ELSE, on the same rule CORE-50K.json states. It is the SECOND SIZE of one plan rather than a second plan, which is the whole content of ADR-024's percent-of-size confirmation: the bp figure is the source and the cents columns are derived, so adding a size is a row rather than a redesign. EVERY CENTS FIGURE BELOW IS THE 50K FIGURE TIMES THREE, WITH EXACTLY ONE EXCEPTION, and the exception is the point: `min_payout_cents` is 10,000 at every size (Appendix A's preamble, GLOSSARY minimum-payout, CV-15). The bp columns are byte-identical to CORE-50K.json because they are the same plan; if a reader finds a bp value here that differs from that file, one of the two is a transcription error rather than a size difference. The floor-lock trigger is the one derived number Appendix A states directly rather than by bp: 760,000 = 750,000 + 10,000, which is CV-12 and is why the floor never jumps when it locks.
